text:
leo: Heads-up: noticed dashboard graph panels spike backend queries when users toggle multi-select filters. RBAC checks seem to be per-row expansions causing big ACL fanout. Thinking we should shift some checks earlier or cache results. Thoughts?

olivia: Yeah saw that on prod last night. Query count jumps ~6x on some dashboards. Could we push RBAC evaluation into the query proxy so we can batch? Concern: auth cache TTL and staleness.

aj: Want concrete tradeoffs. If we do proxy-level RBAC we avoid repeated DB lookups per widget, but we may increase memory for expanded ids. Also changes the failure modes (auth svc becomes single point).

maria: @aj +1. Also need to think about SLO: panel 95p latency target 250ms. Adding proxy compute might push us over. But we can add async prefetch for common filters.

noah: What about sampling + partial results? For very large teams we can return guarded previews and lazy load full results. UI shows "preview" state with a CTA to load full.

leo: Proposal: short-term: auth expansion cache keyed by (user|org|selector-hash) TTL=60s; do expansion once per dashboard load; then share across panels. Long-term: move to policy engine that returns compact predicates so DB can apply filter server-side instead of client-side expansion.

aj: Implementation sketch:
```
1) request -> dashboard-proxy
2) proxy checks auth-cache (key = user|org|sel-hash)
3) if miss -> policy engine -> expansion -> cache
4) panels use expanded predicate (or predicate token)
```

olivia: Edge cases: revocation latency. If role removed, 60s TTL could leak. We should invalidate cache on role-change events and emit an audit event.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary for proxy change scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC. Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with kill-switch.

maria: Add metrics: cache_hit_rate, expansion_size_histogram, per_dashboard_query_count, panel_95p_latency pre/post. Also an alert if expansion_size > 2000 or hit_rate < 0.7.

leo: Agree. I'll do an RFC follow-up with bench numbers and perf targets. Owners: leo (RFC), aj (proxy impl), olivia (policy engine), maria (metrics/alerts).

noah: :thumbsup: I'll mock the UI fallback for partial results and the load-full UX.
